items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: But when we came back, Ed Fox... His son was in the publishing business

ctx.x: shouldn't have happened to me! But we came back. Everywhere we played was heavy. The crowds were tremendous. But when we came back, Ed Fox... His son was in the publishing business, and we started getting in tunes that he was publishing, to get them on the air. And what they was doing was, they'd have somebody make an arrangement, make the introduction, and play the first melody to establish the melody, then they'd either give me a chorus or Chu a chorus, and then they'd take it on out. And you know, we had a lot…

Because they'd been trying to get... Me and Chu used to go the Three Deuces and jam. The only reason we went down there is because we used to get good ribs there. And it was nice playing. Art was working there. Zutty had a group down there, and I think Vernell York(?) was working with him.
